about.title: About LosEstate
about.lead: For more than 15 years, we have been creating added value where others see only square meters.
about.body: LosEstate is an international team of experts specializing in the full cycle of real estate investment. Over a decade and a half, we have grown from local transactions to delivering large-scale projects in Poland, Turkey, and Spain. Our experience allows us to work equally effectively with historic commercial properties requiring deep reconstruction and high-tech new developments.

specializations.title: Revitalization and reconstruction
specializations.text: We take outdated commercial spaces and hotels and transform them into modern, high-yield assets.

specializations.title: Investment consulting
specializations.text: We help investors find properties with the best growth potential and ensure legal transparency of transactions.

specializations.title: Rental management
specializations.text: We handle operational management of apartments and hotel complexes, maximizing returns for owners.

specializations.title: New developments
specializations.text: Deep market understanding allows us to be among the first to select the most promising modern projects.

whyItems.title: International reach
whyItems.text: We are deeply integrated into the markets of Poland, Turkey, and Spain, understanding their specifics, tax legislation, and cultural nuances.

whyItems.title: Full-cycle professionalism
whyItems.text: We don't just facilitate the transaction — we build an ownership and management strategy, from the initial property inspection to optimizing its profitability.

whyItems.title: Security and experience
whyItems.text: 15 years in the market means thousands of successfully completed cases and an impeccable reputation. We know how to minimize risks when working with any type of real estate.

about.closing: At LosEstate, we believe: real estate is not just a building. It is a tool that, with proper management, becomes the foundation of your financial well-being.

alanya-guzelyali-suites.title: Alanya Güzelyalı — Beachfront Suite Apartment Project
alanya-guzelyali-suites.description: Our completed suite apartment project of 24 independent units is located on parcel 5, block 2506 in Alanya district of Antalya, on Güzelyalı Street, Muhabbet Sokak, in a beachfront position. It sits in one of Alanya's prime coastal areas, directly on Damlataş Beach and within walking distance of Kleopatra Beach. A key location advantage is its position opposite the cable car that reduces travel time to Alanya Castle to just 5 minutes. This is a full restoration project: all apartments, common areas, and exterior façades have been renovated from scratch. Every room is equipped with brand-new air conditioning.
